_help: Gallery for the Services & Projects page and the Home page preview. kind: 'inspiration' = third-party photo shown for ideas (needs a full 'credit'); 'project' = the owner's own completed work (only when it really is). 'featured': true shows it on the Home page (4 recommended). Photo files live in src/assets/img/. Record every third-party photo in docs/image-credits.md. See docs/setup-and-deployment.md.

items.title: Reflecting pool and palms
items.caption: A still pool dotted with giant lily pads, framed by tall palms and open sky. Water, space and a few bold plants give the scene its calm, modern feel.
items.place: Burle Marx Plaza, Naples Botanical Garden, Naples, FL

photo.alt: Pool with giant round lily pads, framed by tall palms and layered tropical planting under a blue sky

items.title: Formal parterre garden
items.caption: Clipped hedges in a repeating pattern, gravel walks and statuary. Symmetry gives a garden calm, timeless order, and the idea scales down to a pair of matching beds by the front door.

photo.alt: Formal garden with low clipped hedges in geometric beds, gravel paths and classical statues beneath large shade trees

items.title: Raked gravel and a single stone
items.caption: Pale raked gravel and one weathered boulder against a plain wall. Restraint and texture do the work, with very little to maintain.
items.place: Morikami Museum and Japanese Gardens, Delray Beach, FL

photo.alt: Minimal rock garden with raked pale gravel and a large weathered stone in front of a plain yellow wall

items.title: Layered tropical beds
items.caption: Bands of red, orange and green foliage beneath shade trees, with a soft lawn path leading you through. Layering low, medium and tall plants makes a bed feel full and finished.

photo.alt: Garden beds of colorful red, orange and green tropical foliage beneath shade trees beside a curving lawn

items.title: Sun-and-sand garden
items.caption: Palms and drought-tolerant plants set in pale sand. It's a good example of a Florida-friendly principle: choose plants that suit a dry, sunny, sandy spot instead of fighting it.
items.place: Bonnet House Museum & Gardens, Fort Lauderdale, FL

photo.alt: Sandy garden with palms, spiky drought-tolerant plants and low shrubs under a bright blue sky

items.title: Arbor over a garden path
items.caption: A simple white arbor turns an ordinary walkway into an entrance. Dense planting on both sides makes the path feel like you're stepping into somewhere special.

photo.alt: White garden arbor over a paved path, with lush green shrubs and trees on both sides

items.title: Compact tropical courtyard
items.caption: A brick path winds between palms and broad-leaf plants. Layering tall, medium and low plants makes a small courtyard feel deeper and more private than it is.
items.place: Ernest Hemingway Home and Museum, Key West, FL

photo.alt: Small courtyard garden with a brick path curving between palms and large-leaved tropical plants

items.title: Flowering path to the gate
items.caption: A curving brick path edged with flowering shrubs and a white fence. Color along the walk is a simple way to make a small front yard feel welcoming.

photo.alt: Curving red brick path bordered by flowering shrubs and green lawn, with a white fence and house in the background
